newsitem.title: UK: UK'S ROYAL SUN SAYS PENSION REVIEW SOON.
newsitem.headline: UK'S ROYAL SUN SAYS PENSION REVIEW SOON.

text.p: British insurance group Royal & Sun Alliance said on Wednesday it was still committed to completing review of its personal pensions as quickly as possible and it had devoted "considerable" resources towards achieving this.

RSA said this after the pensions watchdog, Personal Investment Authority, said that based on information it had, it could not conclude that RSA had met the first deadline in the pensions review timetable set for it.
The timetable required RSA to complete 90 percent of its priority tranche I cases by July 31, 1997.
RSA said it had submitted figures to the PIA on Tuesday, which had achieved the first tranche target it had earlier promised.
RSA said the plan had "made it clear that there would be a number of cases that would be incapable of resolution within the timetable.
